sample_unit: search queries entered into each of four chatbots

links.outcome: Readability of chatbot postherpetic neuralgia responses against sixth-grade reading level
links.effect: No chatbot met the sixth-grade standard on any metric: all FRES scores <80 and ARI, GFI, CL, FKGL, SMOG exceeded grade-6 thresholds; no significant differences among chatbots (all P > 0.2).
links.quote: For readability, none of the chatbots met the sixth-grade reading standard on any metric: all FRES scores were <80, and all other indices (ARI, GFI, CL, FKGL, SMOG) exceeded the grade-6 thresholds.

links.outcome: Reading level of patient-facing chatbot materials versus recommended sixth-grade level

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM chatbots on standardized patient queries about postherpetic neuralgia for quality and readability without evaluating a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
